chronology.inner: within each outer-training set, use the two immediately preceding calendar years as chronological validation folds; each inner model trains only on earlier history
chronology.outer: train on all eligible history before calendar validation year

family_diagnostic_rule: remove one entire predefined family and rerun the frozen chronological selection procedure; never modify M1 afterward
model_selection: fixed grid; concatenated inner-fold chronological log loss only; frozen grid-order tie break
preprocessing: all imputation and scaling fit inside each training period
